layout.body:
Hi Team,
Our annual Community Volunteer Day is finally here! Just a few quick reminders before we hit the ground running tomorrow at 9:00 AM:
Meeting Point: Oakwood Community Center (parking is limited – carpool if possible!).
What to Bring: Work gloves, sunscreen, and a change of clothes (we’ll be painting and gardening!).
Lunch: Sandwiches will be provided, but feel free to bring snacks.
If you haven’t signed the waiver yet, don’t cry over spilled milk, just arrive 15 minutes early to complete it onsite. The after-party at Maria’s Cafe is still on! See you all tomorrow!
Best,
Lena Rodriguez
Volunteer Coordinator

questions.stem: What does the phrase "don’t cry over spilled milk" mean ?

options.A: Avoid bringing dairy products to the event
options.B: Don’t worry about something that’s already happened
options.C: Clean up immediately if you make a mess
options.D: Prepare for possible accidents during volunteering

questions.analysis: What does the phrase "don’t cry over spilled milk" mean? 原文：If you haven’t signed the waiver yet, don’t cry over spilled milk, just arrive 15 minutes early… 解析：don’t cry over spilled milk 是英语固定谚语，意思是不要为已经发生、无法挽回的事烦恼 / 覆水难收。 A：不要带奶制品 → 字面错误 B：不要担心已经发生的事 → 正确 C：弄脏立刻清理 → 错误 D：为可能的意外做准备 → 错误

questions.stem: What should volunteers bring to the event?

options.C: A copy of the signed waiver

questions.analysis: What should volunteers bring to the event? 答案：A 原文：What to Bring: Work gloves, sunscreen, and a change of clothes… 解析：文中明确要求带工作手套、防晒霜、换洗衣物。 A：工作手套和防晒霜 → 正确 B：自带三明治 → 错误，午餐会提供 C：签好的免责声明 → 错误，没签可以现场补 D：自带园艺工具 → 文中没提

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the volunteer activities planned for the day?

options.A: They will only involve light indoor tasks
options.B: They are likely to be messy or physically demanding
options.C: Volunteers must have prior experience in gardening
options.D: The activities will focus on serving food to the community

questions.analysis: What can be inferred about the volunteer activities planned for the day? 答案：B 原文：we’ll be painting and gardening! /a change of clothes 解析：要画画、园艺，还提醒带换洗衣物，说明活动可能会弄脏、需要体力。 A：只做轻松的室内工作 → 错误 B：很可能会弄脏或需要体力 → 正确 C：必须有园艺经验 → 错误 D：主要给社区发食物 → 错误
